properties.name: openbroker.connections
properties.description: The connections, each named by the key under which it is declared. A connection named kafka or artemis is laid over the one derived from Spring Boot's connection details.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.cluster-endpoints[].address
properties.description: The address of a cluster endpoint, in the form the driver expects (for example host:port for Kafka, a Core URL for Artemis).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.cluster-endpoints[].plane
properties.description: The plane a cluster endpoint serves: management or data.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.cluster-endpoints[].protocol
properties.description: The protocol of a cluster endpoint, as the driver names it (for example kafka, core or jolokia).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.nodes[].endpoints[].address
properties.description: The address of a node endpoint, in the form the driver expects (for example host:port for Kafka, a Core URL for Artemis).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.nodes[].endpoints[].plane
properties.description: The plane a node endpoint serves: management or data.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.nodes[].endpoints[].protocol
properties.description: The protocol of a node endpoint, as the driver names it (for example kafka, core or jolokia).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.nodes[].id
properties.description: The node's id, unique within the cluster. A node of the same id as a derived node adds its endpoints to it.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.cluster.options
properties.description: The driver's connection options, such as security.protocol or sasl.mechanism. The driver declares which keys exist; an unknown key fails the start.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.credentials.expires-at
properties.description: When the bearer token expires, for the form bearer-token (every plane).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.credentials.form
properties.description: The form of the credentials for every plane: username-password, bearer-token or none. Unset means the connection sets none.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.credentials.password
properties.description: The password, for the form username-password (every plane). Never logged.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.credentials.token
properties.description: The bearer token, for the form bearer-token (every plane). Never logged.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.credentials.username
properties.description: The user name, for the form username-password (every plane).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.management-credentials.expires-at
properties.description: When the bearer token expires, for the form bearer-token (the management plane).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.management-credentials.form
properties.description: The form of the credentials for the management plane: username-password, bearer-token or none. Unset means the connection sets none.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.management-credentials.password
properties.description: The password, for the form username-password (the management plane). Never logged.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.management-credentials.token
properties.description: The bearer token, for the form bearer-token (the management plane). Never logged.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.management-credentials.username
properties.description: The user name, for the form username-password (the management plane).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.call-timeout
properties.description: How long a call may take. Defaults to openbroker.client.call-timeout.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long a connection attempt may take. Defaults to openbroker.client.connect-timeout.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.max-response-bytes
properties.description: The largest response the client reads, in bytes. Defaults to openbroker.client.max-response-bytes.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.spool-directory
properties.description: Where the client spools large bodies. Defaults to openbroker.client.spool-directory.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.ssl-bundle
properties.description: The name of the Spring SSL bundle (spring.ssl.bundle) that supplies TLS. Unset means no TLS from a bundle.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.options.verify-hostname
properties.description: Whether the server's host name is checked against its certificate.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.concurrency
properties.description: How many messages a processor handles at once, from 1 to 64.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.ordering
properties.description: The ordering a processor keeps.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.filter.dialect
properties.description: The dialect of the filter the receiver inside a processor applies.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.filter.expression
properties.description: The filter expression the receiver inside a processor applies, in the named dialect.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.flow.max-unsettled
properties.description: The most messages the receiver inside a processor holds delivered but not settled.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.flow.prefetch-bytes
properties.description: How many bytes the receiver inside a processor fetches ahead.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.flow.prefetch-messages
properties.description: How many messages the receiver inside a processor fetches ahead.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.guarantee
properties.description: The delivery guarantee of the receiver inside a processor: at-most-once, at-least-once or transacted.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.mode
properties.description: Whether the receiver inside a processor consumes or browses.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.produced-at-or-before
properties.description: Only messages produced at or before this instant are received by the receiver inside a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.recovery.backoff.initial
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of the receiver inside a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.recovery.backoff.jitter
properties.type: The share of each delay that is random, from 0 to 1
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of the receiver inside a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.recovery.backoff.max
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of the receiver inside a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.recovery.backoff.multiplier
properties.type: How much each delay grows over the last
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of the receiver inside a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.receive.recovery.give-up-after
properties.description: How long the receiver inside a processor keeps trying to recover a lost link before it gives up. Unset means never.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.backoff.initial
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between retries of a message in a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.backoff.jitter
properties.type: The share of each delay that is random, from 0 to 1
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between retries of a message in a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.backoff.max
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between retries of a message in a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.backoff.multiplier
properties.type: How much each delay grows over the last
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between retries of a message in a processor.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: How many times a message is tried before it is given up on.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.retry.mode
properties.description: Who retries a failed message: the default, the system or the client (managed).

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.processor.stop-grace
properties.description: How long a stopping processor lets in-flight handlers finish.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.filter.dialect
properties.description: The dialect of the filter a receiver applies.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.filter.expression
properties.description: The filter expression a receiver applies, in the named dialect.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.flow.max-unsettled
properties.description: The most messages a receiver holds delivered but not settled.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.flow.prefetch-bytes
properties.description: How many bytes a receiver fetches ahead.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.flow.prefetch-messages
properties.description: How many messages a receiver fetches ahead.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.guarantee
properties.description: The delivery guarantee of a receiver: at-most-once, at-least-once or transacted.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.mode
properties.description: Whether a receiver consumes or browses.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.produced-at-or-before
properties.description: Only messages produced at or before this instant are received by a receiver.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.recovery.backoff.initial
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of a receiver.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.recovery.backoff.jitter
properties.type: The share of each delay that is random, from 0 to 1
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of a receiver.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.recovery.backoff.max
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of a receiver.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.recovery.backoff.multiplier
properties.type: How much each delay grows over the last
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of a receiver.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.receiver.recovery.give-up-after
properties.description: How long a receiver keeps trying to recover a lost link before it gives up. Unset means never.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.buffer.max-block
properties.description: How long a send waits for room in the buffer before it fails.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.buffer.max-bytes
properties.description: The most bytes a sender holds unconfirmed.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.buffer.max-in-flight
properties.description: The most messages a sender holds unconfirmed.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.deduplication
properties.description: Which duplicates a sender asks the broker to drop.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.guarantee
properties.description: The delivery guarantee of a sender: at-most-once, at-least-once or transacted.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.ordering
properties.description: The ordering a sender keeps.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.recovery.backoff.initial
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of a sender.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.recovery.backoff.jitter
properties.type: The share of each delay that is random, from 0 to 1
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of a sender.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.recovery.backoff.max
properties.description: java.time.Duration of the delay between recovery attempts of a sender.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.recovery.backoff.multiplier
properties.type: How much each delay grows over the last
properties.description: java.lang.Double of the delay between recovery attempts of a sender.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.sender.recovery.give-up-after
properties.description: How long a sender keeps trying to recover a lost link before it gives up. Unset means never.

properties.name: openbroker.connections.*.system
properties.description: The broker system, such as kafka or artemis. Required unless the connection is derived from Spring Boot's connection details.

properties.name: openbroker.client.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long a connection attempt may take, for every connection.

properties.name: openbroker.client.call-timeout
properties.description: How long a call may take, for every connection.

properties.name: openbroker.client.max-response-bytes
properties.description: The largest response the client reads, in bytes, for every connection.

properties.name: openbroker.client.spool-directory
properties.description: Where the client spools large bodies, for every connection. Defaults to openbroker-spool under java.io.tmpdir.
